title: Holistic Automated Red Teaming for Large Language Models through Top-Down Test Case Generation and Multi-turn Interaction
reasoning: The paper identifies 'Unethical and Immoral' and 'Environmental and Social Ethics' as two of its eight core 'Meta Risk Categories' used to evaluate Large Language Models. Furthermore, it includes a specific attack vector (A6: Dilemma) designed to simulate moral dilemmas like the trolley problem to benchmark model responses against ethical standards.
